title: Yatra – Hadlee Xavier Latest Telugu Christian Song Lyrics
translation: You have enlightened my lamp
you alone are the radiant one to me
being the king of kings and my master
this boat that you guided belongs to you
now i will carry forward my life
only along your path on this earth
until this earthly journey comes to an end
please stay with me, o lord
You have guided me within you
my entire journey is spent with you
this sacrifice on calvary was just for me, wasn’t it?
you have rescued and protected me
lest i fall down during this journey
keep guiding me with you, o god
strengthen me with your power, o god
you alone are my strength and glory
Giving me an inheritance with you
in the heavenly realms
bearing witness to your light
letting me remain as your witness
you have given me life today
so that i may do your service
having tasted and known, i have taught
you alone are my teacher
your friendship is supreme
there is no one mightier than you
you gave all your love to me
you are the embodiment of love, O Jesus

credits.Theme: Christian Journey, Faith, Grace and God’s Guidance

intro: Yatra (యాత్ర) is the latest Telugu Christian song sung, arranged and music composed & sung by Hadlee Xavier. This song was released on July 10, 2026, through Hadlee Xavier YouTube Channel.
